# Isaiah Chapter 20 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 6 verses]*

*Sign-act against Egypt and Cush; three years naked; warning against relying on Egypt*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 20 (Isaiah's Symbolic Act) addresses sign-act against egypt and cush; three years naked; warning against relying on egypt. The key verse — "Isaiah walked naked and barefoot three years as a sign" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
